<a id="ASM-011"></a>
### ASM-011

A policy-violating leave request follows the normal review path: the chosen Project Manager confirms or denies it first, then the Line Manager approves or rejects it. The Line Manager's approval step is the manual review, and the violation is shown to the Line Manager. No extra review step (e.g. by HR) is added.

**Related:**

- [REQ-003](requirements.view.md#REQ-003) Accept policy-violating leave requests for manual review
- [REQ-006](requirements.view.md#REQ-006) Confirm or deny a leave request
- [REQ-008](requirements.view.md#REQ-008) Approve or reject a confirmed leave request
- [Q-004](open-questions.view.md#Q-004) How is a policy-violating leave request reviewed? (1) Who performs the "manual review": the normal Project Manager then Line Manager steps with the violation highlighted, or an additional review (e.g. by HR)? (2) Which violations are allowed through (e.g. exceeding the remaining entitlement, a leave type the employee is not eligible for, a missing required document)? (3) If approved, what happens to the excess (negative balance, converted to unpaid leave, other)?

<a id="ASM-012"></a>
### ASM-012

The month-end cancellation is done automatically by the system (a scheduled job), without any user action.

**Related:**

- [REQ-034](requirements.view.md#REQ-034) Cancel leave requests not completed by the end of the leave start month
- [REQ-009](requirements.view.md#REQ-009) Complete review and approval within the leave start month
- [Q-003](open-questions.view.md#Q-003) What happens to a leave request that is not confirmed or not approved by the end of the calendar month of its leave start date? Options: (a) it stays pending and can still be acted on; (b) it expires or is cancelled automatically; (c) it is rejected automatically; (d) it is approved automatically; (e) it is escalated (to whom?). And how does the rule apply to leave that spans two months, or to a past-date request submitted on the last day of the month?

<a id="ASM-013"></a>
### ASM-013

A leave request whose period includes any day of a month before the submission month is not accepted as a whole, even if it also includes days of the current month; the employee requests only the current-month days. Leave that starts in the current month and continues into the next month is accepted.

**Related:**

- [REQ-001](requirements.view.md#REQ-001) Submit leave request
- [Q-003](open-questions.view.md#Q-003) What happens to a leave request that is not confirmed or not approved by the end of the calendar month of its leave start date? Options: (a) it stays pending and can still be acted on; (b) it expires or is cancelled automatically; (c) it is rejected automatically; (d) it is approved automatically; (e) it is escalated (to whom?). And how does the rule apply to leave that spans two months, or to a past-date request submitted on the last day of the month?

<a id="ASM-014"></a>
### ASM-014

The employee chooses the confirming Project Manager on each leave request, at submission; only the chosen Project Manager confirms or denies that request. With a single assigned project, that project's Project Manager is the only choice.

**Related:**

- [REQ-001](requirements.view.md#REQ-001) Submit leave request
- [REQ-006](requirements.view.md#REQ-006) Confirm or deny a leave request
- [REQ-020](requirements.view.md#REQ-020) Action dashboards for Project Managers and Line Managers
- [Q-002](open-questions.view.md#Q-002) Who confirms a leave request when the employee belongs to several projects (several Project Managers) or to no project? Options: (a) every Project Manager of the projects the leave dates affect; (b) any one of them; (c) a designated primary Project Manager; (d) with no project, the request goes straight to the Line Manager.
